name: print-social-bonus-card-posts-blue-checkerboard-zigzag-ribbon
title: 'Bonus Card' Instagram pack in cobalt blue with a checkerboard-and-zigzag ribbon and red/yellow corner stars
whatItIs: Nine cobalt blue square posts with a black-yellow-pink zigzag ribbon and checkerboard band running diagonally, red and yellow starburst corner tags, black-and-white photos of hands holding a card and phone, and bold headlines ('When Bills Go Smart', 'Buy Smart With Our Card', 'Be Smart, Use the Card').
whatItMeans: Retro and confident; a bold graphic ribbon across every post gives a fintech product an unexpectedly playful identity.
techniques: Run one diagonal zigzag-and-checkerboard ribbon across an entire post set.
Use small starburst corner tags as consistent branding.
Keep photos greyscale so the ribbon carries all the colour.

vocabulary.definition: A diagonal decorative band with a jagged edge.
A small spiky badge shape used as a corner accent.
